caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely about flat, predictable terrain. It is about understanding the clay under your tires, the sudden shifts in gradient, and the way the forest opens up to reveal a completely different valley. When I design routes for My Adventure Costa Rica, I look for these old access roads—passages carved into the hillsides that connect remote mountain communities. They require focus, but they reward you with a perspective of this country that paved roads can never offer.
